title: NATS settings
description: Server identity, JetStream, client password, and message limits of one NATS server.

serverName.title: Server name
serverName.description: The NATS server_name, always the instance name.

jetstream.title: JetStream
jetstream.description: Store streams and key value buckets in the instance's data folder. File streams survive a restart, memory streams do not. Off means core messaging only, and nothing is stored.

clientPassword.title: Client password
clientPassword.description: Password of the stackly user that clients sign in with. A new value takes effect at the next restart.

jetstreamMaxMemoryMiB.title: JetStream memory limit (MiB)
jetstreamMaxMemoryMiB.description: Most memory JetStream memory streams may use.

jetstreamMaxFileMiB.title: JetStream file limit (MiB)
jetstreamMaxFileMiB.description: Most disk space JetStream file streams may use in the data folder.

maxPayloadKiB.title: Largest message (KiB)
maxPayloadKiB.description: Largest message payload a client may publish.
